# Inter-Agent Handoff Template (PRD §42)

```text
TASK: [Current task identifier]
OBJECTIVE: [Precise goal of this handoff]
CURRENT STATE: [Current implementation status]
WORK COMPLETED: [Concrete changes and deliverables produced]
FILES AFFECTED: [List of modified or created file paths]
DECISIONS: [Key architectural or domain decisions made]
EVIDENCE: [Automated test output or verification evidence]
ASSUMPTIONS: [Explicit assumptions needing validation]
RISKS: [Known edge cases or failure modes]
UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS: [Any open uncertainties]
NEXT ACTION: [Exact step the consuming agent should take]
REQUIRED APPROVAL: [None | Human Founder | System Architect]
```
